map.I级 无心衰征象: Class I - no heart failure signs
map.II级 啰音<50%肺野/S3: Class II - rales <50% lung fields / S3
map.III级 啰音≥50%肺野/肺水肿: Class III - rales >=50% lung fields / pulmonary edema
map.提示：GRACE评分适用于NSTE-ACS（非ST段抬高型急性冠脉综合征）及ST: Note: GRACE applies to NSTE-ACS (non-ST-elevation ACS) and STEMI. High-risk patients suggest early invasive strategy (coronary angiography within 24h); low-risk can be conservatively treated or elective angiography. For clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：GRACE 评分死亡风险评估器: 📚 In-depth: GRACE Score Mortality Risk Assessor
map.GRACE 评分累加（院内死亡/缺血事件）：年龄、心率、收缩压、肌酐、Killi: GRACE scoring (in-hospital death/ischemia): age, heart rate, systolic BP, creatinine, Killip, myocardial injury markers, ST deviation, cardiac arrest history weighted, total 0-372.
map.危险分层：分值对应院内与 6 个月死亡/缺血风险，高分（如 >140）倾向早期侵: Risk stratification: score maps in-hospital and 6-month death/ischemia risk; high (e.g. >140) leans early invasive (angiography + PCI).
map.血运重建时机：高危 NSTE-ACS 建议 24h 内造影，极高危（血流动力学不: Revascularization timing: high-risk NSTE-ACS suggest angiography within 24h; very high-risk (hemodynamic instability, repeated ischemia) immediate.
map.输入：男、68 岁、心率 102、收缩压 100、肌酐 130、Killip I: Input: male, 68, HR 102, SBP 100, creatinine 130, Killip I, troponin elevated, ST depression, no arrest. Output: GRACE ~138, high risk, advice invasive within 24h (angiography + PCI if needed), warn seek care on recurrent ischemia. Note: score varies with indicators; bedside prevails.
map.GRACE 与 TIMI 有何区别？: How does GRACE differ from TIMI?
map.GRACE 覆盖更广（含血压、肌酐、Killip 等），预测院内与远期死亡/缺血: GRACE covers more (BP, creatinine, Killip), more robust for in-hospital and long-term death/ischemia; TIMI for NSTE-ACS ischemia with fewer items. Complementary; guidelines often pick GRACE for invasive timing.
map.高危就一定要造影吗？: High risk means angiography for sure?
map.高危 NSTE-ACS 推荐早期（多 24h 内）冠脉造影，极高危（心源性休克、: High-risk NSTE-ACS recommends early (often within 24h) angiography; very high-risk (cardiogenic shock, refractory ischemia, lethal arrhythmia) immediate; but timing also depends on stability, bleeding risk and team.
map.评分会随病情变吗？: Does the score change with condition?
map.会。血压、心率、肌酐、标志物在就诊过程中动态变化，GRACE 应据最新值重评；趋: Yes. BP, HR, creatinine, markers change dynamically during visit; GRACE should be re-estimated with latest values; trend beats single value for deterioration or improvement, guiding monitoring and re-evaluation.
